name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
detailed_description:
Zozo is a 10 year-old boy who has always dreamt of being a superhero One day, he uses Dream Machine to enter his dream and play his fantasy as superhero. However, a mysterious incident cuased him to get trapped in dream world. He must go on adventure to find ways to get back home. Join Zozo as he explores through the bizarre dream world packed with quirky character, peculiar enemies, funny stories, and surprises that’ll keep you on your toes.

  • Cartoonish Fun : Inspired by classic sunday morning cartoon, the game delivers a humorous and heartwarming narratives. There will be a ton of jokes and comedic bit, but also sweet and heartwarming story about friendship and dreams.

  • Episodic Storytelling : The story is delivered through 7 episode, each with their own premise, build up, plot twist, and climax. With each episode build up the story that culminated into the finale episode. Complete with opening and ending theme song to bring you back to the good old times.

  • Explore Colorful and Vibrant World : Each world is inspired by various genres of classic cartoon and movies, providing unique experience and intriguing world to explore. From magical desert made of dessert, to sci-fi themed jungle, to alien themed martial art, each world have distinct visual to match its genre of inspiration.

  • Make New Friends : As zozo explores each world, he meet quirky characters that ended up becoming member of Zozo’s squad. They travel together to investigate the incident and helping Zozo find ways to go home.
